rules: .drawer { position: fixed; z-index: 1000; top: 0px; width: 300px; height: 100%; padding: 0px 25px; transition: 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.46, 0.01, 0.32, 1); background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); color: rgb(0, 0, 0); }
.drawer__inside { display: none; position: relative; height: 100%; margin: 0px -35px 0px 0px; padding: 0px 35px 25px 0px; overflow: hidden scroll; }
.site-header__search-trigger { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; padding: 10px; background-color: transparent; border: 0px; cursor: pointer; }

.modal.drawer-view { inset: auto 0px 0px auto; width: 100vw; height: auto; max-height: 91vh; padding-bottom: 80px; overflow: auto; transform: translateY(80px); border-radius: 32px 32px 0px 0px; opacity: 1; background-color: rgb(247, 241, 249); }

@screen and (min-width: 1025px) .modal.drawer-view { width: 504px; height: 100vh; max-height: none; padding-right: 80px; padding-bottom: 0px; transform: translate(80px); border-radius: 32px 0px 0px 32px; }
.modal.drawer-view.hidden { transform: translateY(100%); transition: 0.4s cubic-bezier(0.5, -0.5, 0.25, 1.4), opacity linear 0.4s; opacity: 0; }

[data-drawer="search"] { z-index: 1001; backdrop-filter: blur(12px); visibility: hidden; opacity: 0; background-color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.8); width: 100%; max-width: 450px; transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.46, 0.01, 0.32, 1), opacity 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.46, 0.01, 0.32, 1); position: fixed; top: 111px; bottom: 0px; right: 0px; transform: translate(100%); }
